description: drowzeys' four-Spark serve of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (763B MoE) as the TR3-Hybrid quant (EXL3-TR3 K=3 tail experts plus 64 native MXFP4 keep experts per layer, about 3.22 bpw MoE mix, 410 GB checkpoint incl. 203 GB Engram): vLLM dsv41-feat e47aa780b with DSpark k=5 speculative decoding, the TR3/B12X plugin, CUDA graphs (FULL_AND_PIECEWISE), native vision (4 images per prompt), tool calling and the deepseek_v41 reasoning parser, TP4, 1,048,576-token context, 8 sequences, 2048 batched tokens, GPU memory 0.81, thinking off by default. Upstream reports (not measured here): about 8.7M-token KV pool at 0.81 (9,452,923 measured at 0.83, selectable as an option), 1M needle-in-haystack pass, C1 up to 44.6 tok/s and C8 aggregate up to 171 tok/s, KL 0.032 nats vs native over 66.6K positions. Licences: MIT (DeepSeek weights and the drowzeys checkpoint and recipe). Not gated. Upstream also documents an abliterated overlay (drowzeys/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-Abliterated-Cybersecurity-Unleashed, a gated Hugging Face repository that cannot be pinned without access) applied to the checkpoint by a separate graft step before serving; it is not part of this recipe. Needs four Sparks on the 200G RoCE fabric; 440 GB of model files per node. GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. This is a conservative budget, not a measured footprint.
title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash TR3-Hybrid vLLM four Sparks (drowzeys)
